Ongoing — no recovery yet. Log ends mid-incident, so the outage is still live as of the last entry.

## On-call handoff — gateway 503s

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) shipped a config change — "connection-per-request for pool isolation" — flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change burns through the connection pool per request instead of sharing connections, and the pool (fixed at 20) collapsed within seconds of the deploy finishing.

**Impact window:** Started **2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC**, still ongoing as of the last log line (**03:59:27 UTC**) — 1h45m and counting. Every request is failing with `503 ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, pool stuck at 20/20 in_use with the wait queue climbing (13 waiting at the start, 74 by the end). Hits all routes and all backing services (`billing-svc`, `orders-svc`, `catalog-svc`, `accounts-svc`) — this is the shared gateway pool, not one backend.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` shows every job finishing clean through the same window (`db_wait` under 15ms) — workers use a separate pool and were never affected.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on gateway — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
